text:
maria_ops: Quick follow-up from last postmortem — recurring noisy pages from model-serving (403 spikes) are still hitting rotation. I put a short remediation list here: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-remediation-list. Need owners + rough ETA so we can lock the runbook and suppression policy. TL;DR items: 1) dedupe by request signature, 2) adjust threshold/aggregation, 3) add short suppression window for bursty client, 4) synthetic canary to catch config regressions, 5) monthly audit job for alert churn.

ajay_oncall: I can pick up 1 (dedupe key) and 3 (suppression window). Thinking 2-week sprint for changes + 1 week for monitoring. Will draft PR and test on staging.

clare_sre: I'll take 2 (threshold/aggregation) and 5 (monthly audit). Need baseline metrics — can someone drop a 30d p95/p99 for the 403 alert? Prefer to do a gradual bump (10% then 25% if stable).

ops-bot: Incident summary for 2025-03-11: model-serving high 403 rate -> 42 pages, peak 02:13 UTC, mean RTT unaffected. Pager rotation: oncall-team-a.

nick_dev: Before bumping thresholds, let's add a short canary rule scoped to 10% of traffic so we don't blind ourselves to real regressions. I can help wire that into the deploy pipeline.

emma_prod: For dedupe key, recommend using (endpoint + client_id + truncated body hash). That avoids collapsing unrelated failures. Also +1 for synthetic canary.

ajay_oncall: Draft of proposed alert rule snippet (staging proof-of-concept):
```
alert: High403Rate
expr: sum(rate(http_responses_total{code="403"}[5m])) by (endpoint, client_id) > 50
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: high
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/high-403.md"
```
We'll add a dedupe key in the paging config: key: "{{endpoint}}:{{client_id}}:{{hash(body,8)}}" and suppression_window: 2m for same key.

clare_sre: That looks good. For rollout: can we do a canary for 48h targeting non-prod -> 10% prod -> global? Also want dashboards to show dedupe impact.

maria_ops: OK — owners and rough ETAs: ajay (dedupe + suppression) — 3w, clare (thresholds + audit) — 4w, nick (canary infra) — 2w, emma (review dedupe key) — quick review during PR. Please add your items to the remediation tracker doc (same link) and set a Github issue with the tag "pm-followup/alert-tuning". I'll run a sync Friday 10:00am UTC to review progress.

ajay_oncall: Adding issues now. PR draft by Tues.

nick_dev: Will start canary tickets, assigning to myself.

clare_sre: I'll populate baseline numbers in the tracker by EOD tomorrow.

emma_prod: LGTM, will review PR. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Thanks team — if anyone hits blockers (esp. infra quota for canaries) ping me directly and I'll escalate.

ajay_oncall: ack :white_check_mark:
